Messages.Author: niko...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
If I control a tapped Miguel and my predator tries to take control of
him, but I play Diamond Thunderbolt, does he untap and remain under my
control, or does he also remain tapped?

Miguel
Camarilla: During your predator`s minion phase, your predator may burn
a pool to untap and take control of Miguel until the end of the minion
phase. +1 bleed.

DT
Master: out-of-turn. Only usable when control of a vampire you control
is about to change or when a vampire you control is about to enter
combat. Control of that vampire does not change, and that vampire
gains 1 blood.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
niko...@hotmail.com wrote:
> If I control a tapped Miguel and my predator tries to take control of
> him, but I play Diamond Thunderbolt, does he untap and remain under my
> control, or does he also remain tapped?

Untaps. Diamond Thunderbolt prevents only control from changing. The rest of the
effect is applies as normal. You predator still burns a pool, and Miguel still
untaps.
